Authorized local L3 verified USB disconnect, short charger insertion/removal, reconnect, 250 contiguous retained RAM records and non-consuming replay; returned to native umi Fastboot. This is diagnostic logging evidence, not charging safety or calibrated battery telemetry. Evidence: docs/archive/hardware/2026-11-08-charging-log.md.
